Item-level prior-exposure audit for the exact proposed diagnostic observation

freeze.detail: Commit fd3f334 freezes R1–R7, frame/human-reading gates and deterministic letter outcomes. It reserves no certified unused observation; meaning and archaeology remain separate claims.

outcomes.label: One registered string alone survives
outcomes.condition: Frame/authentication and human-scoring gates pass; every component is decisive; exactly one of R1–R7 survives and no unresolved extra sign remains.
consequences: Record support relative to R1–R7 for letter identity, with every rejected component and frame.
Use the surviving reading in a separate linguistic argument; preserve the archaeological registry.
Claim an unused prediction only if the prior-exposure audit actually certifies the reserved observation.
remaining_unknowns: Meaning/cancellation intent, attachment of north, Koḥlit/Janoaḥ geography and deposit survival
Independent-confirmation status unless unused observation is demonstrably established
outcomes.claim_scope: The engraved second word of XII 10 only; no geographic or archaeological identification.

outcomes.label: Several strings or components remain unresolved
outcomes.condition: Authenticated usable views resolve some components, but two or more strings survive, an extra sign is ambiguous, or the full word is not decisive.
consequences: Publish the component verdicts and all surviving R1–R7 strings.
Close the complete-word claim as not identifiable from the supplied evidence; do not choose the string that best fits a site.
remaining_unknowns: The unresolved letter components and surviving complete strings
outcomes.claim_scope: The engraved second word of XII 10 only; no geographic or archaeological identification.

outcomes.condition: At least one decisive component contradicts each complete R1–R7 string under the frozen absence/damage gates.
consequences: Reject the finite registered set and transcribe the observed sequence without promoting an unregistered interpretation.
Any expanded reading set starts a separately dated exploratory specification.
remaining_unknowns: An interpretation of the observed sequence
outcomes.claim_scope: The engraved second word of XII 10 only; no geographic or archaeological identification.

Name the failed gate; no invisible component is scored absent and no generative or classifier reconstruction decides it.

outcomes.claim_scope: The engraved second word of XII 10 only; no geographic or archaeological identification.
